simple.meaning: סְאָה (çᵉʼâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a seah , or certain measure (as determinative ) for grain.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 18:6. The surrounding context includes altar, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סְאָה (H5429) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: סְאָה (çᵉʼâh) / H5429 is traced through Genesis 18:6, 1 Samuel 25:18, 1 Kings 18:32, 2 Kings 7:1 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a seah , or certain measure (as determinative ) for grain
definitions.full: H5429. seah סְאָה noun feminine (see below ) se'ah , a measure of flour, grain, etc. (√ unknown; perhaps foreign word; Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic סָאתָא סְאָה, , , , (Greek σάτον , Lewy Fremdwörter 116 f )); — absolute סְאָהֿ 2Kin 7:1 , 16 , וּסֳאָהֿ 7:18 (Baer Ginsb compare Ges § 10h ); dual סָאתַיִם 1Kin 18:32 3 t.; plural סְאִים Gen 18:6 ; 1Sam 25:18 ; — always with appositive of thing measured, Gen 18:6 (J), 1Sam 25:18 ; 1Kin 18:32 ; 2Kin 7:1 (twice in verse); 7:16 (twice in verse); 7:18 (twice in verse) (where apparently masculine, perhaps after analogy of other measures of capacity, כֹּר תֹמֶר, הִין, , etc., Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 95 ); — סַאסְּאָה Isa 27:8 see סאסא . — On size of se'ah = 1/3 ephah, = 12.148 litres (= 10.696 qts.), see Now Archaeology i. 203 Benz Archaeology 183 .
